{% set blend_items = [] %}
{% for i in range(1, 11) %}
{% if _context.get('blend_' ~ i|string ~ '_id') %}
{% set _ = blend_items.append(i) %}
{% endif %}
{% endfor %}
SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT TOP {{horizon}} 
        t1.MonthId
        {% for i in blend_items %}
        , t{{ i }}.performance AS {{ _context['blend_' ~ i|string ~ '_id'] }}_Performance
        {% endfor %}
    FROM AM.dbo.MonthlyPerformance t1
    {% for i in blend_items[1:] %}
    INNER JOIN AM.dbo.MonthlyPerformance t{{ i }} ON t1.MonthId = t{{ i }}.MonthId
    {% endfor %}
    WHERE t1.ItemId = '{{ _context['blend_1_id'] }}'
    {% for i in blend_items[1:] %}
    AND t{{ i }}.ItemId = '{{ _context['blend_' ~ i|string ~ '_id'] }}'
    {% endfor %}
    ORDER BY t1.MonthId DESC
) AS RecentMonths 
ORDER BY MonthId ASC
